latest.summary: Overall collections stood at INR 2,780 crores in the current quarter, resulting in operating cash flow of approximately INR 1,858 crores. Net cash position stood at approximately INR 15,100 crores, despite a very, very strong dividend payout in the current quarter of close to INR 1,980 crores. The gross margin potential of our development business continues to stand at approximately INR 40,000 crores, with a potential of cash generation of over INR 42,500 crores.
highlights: Overall collections stood at INR 2,780 crores in the current quarter, resulting in operating cash flow of approximately INR 1,858 crores.
Net cash position stood at approximately INR 15,100 crores, despite a very, very strong dividend payout in the current quarter of close to INR 1,980 crores.
The gross margin potential of our development business continues to stand at approximately INR 40,000 crores, with a potential of cash generation of over INR 42,500 crores.
The portfolio has now achieved its ever-highest occupancy levels: 96% in terms of area and 97% by value.
EBITDA at INR1,537 crores, resulting in a net profit of over INR 750 crores for the current quarter, reflecting a year-over-year growth of 17%.

strengths: Net cash position stood at approximately INR 15,100 crores, despite a very, very strong dividend payout in the current quarter of close to INR 1,980 crores.
The portfolio has now achieved its ever-highest occupancy levels: 96% in terms of area and 97% by value.
We continue to see absolutely strong demand for our super-luxurious project, Dahlias, in the current quarter as well.
